thesis: The interviewee describes King Street Capital as a longstanding debt shop that combines bottom-up and top-down approaches while remaining agnostic to market cycles. He notes that the firm employs a trading strategy rather than a simple buy-and-hold model and possesses deep expertise in liquid, long, short, debt, distress, event-driven, and private debt investments.
